title: Sustainable Mining and Climate Resilience: A Global Review
region: Global, with focus on Sub-Saharan Africa
abstract: This comprehensive report examines sustainable mining practices and their integration with climate resilience strategies. Drawing from case studies across 15 developing nations, the analysis demonstrates how geological assessments can inform climate adaptation planning and reduce environmental impacts from extractive industries. The report provides evidence-based recommendations for policymakers on integrating mining governance with climate action frameworks (SDG 13).
notes: High quality evaluation report with policy recommendations for G20 development partnerships. Includes case studies from South Africa, Ghana, Tanzania, Indonesia, and Peru.
